Animal · 7 hexes · SM +3 Elephant [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: mundane land animals; answers Elephant (SRD 5.1); Elephant (SRD 3.5)]

Six tons of animal that is not remotely stupid, moving in a family group led by the oldest cow. Left alone it ignores people entirely. Provoked, or separated from a calf, it comes forward at a speed nothing that size should manage, and it does not need the tusks to end the argument.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/elephant.gct
  • Independent build total: 176 points of racial traits plus 2 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Elephant (SRD 5.1); Elephant (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Movement: ground Move 5, 7 at a sprint (primary). The published Move folds this creature's Enhanced Move into a single figure.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • The trunk is a fine manipulator, so this build drops No Fine Manipulators from the quadruped set.
